article_title: Is sleep tracking making your sleep worse?

tasks.prompt: What is the central message of the article?
options: Every tracker user has a sleep disorder
Trying to perfect sleep through scores can increase anxiety and worsen sleep
Trackers measure brain activity better than medical tests
tasks.correct_answer: Trying to perfect sleep through scores can increase anxiety and worsen sleep
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התמקדות מוגזמת בציוני שינה עלולה ליצור חרדה ולפגוע בשינה עצמה.

tasks.prompt: What was unusual about the sleep scores in the Oxford study?
options: They were random and unrelated to actual sleep
They came from Jess Hill's watch
tasks.correct_answer: They were random and unrelated to actual sleep
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הציונים הוקצו באקראי ולא שיקפו את השינה האמיתית.

tasks.prompt: According to Dr Neil Stanley, what do wrist-worn trackers mainly measure?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכשירים מודדים בעיקר תנועה; לדבריו, מדידת שינה ממשית דורשת פעילות מוח.

tasks.prompt: What does the Oxford study suggest about tracker information?
options: Believing a poor score can worsen fatigue and alertness even when it is false
tasks.correct_answer: Believing a poor score can worsen fatigue and alertness even when it is false
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האמונה בציון שלילי השפיעה על תחושת העייפות והערנות אף שהציונים היו מזויפים.
to allay fears פירושו להרגיע או להפחית חששות.

options: Turning sleep into a score-based target or competition
tasks.correct_answer: Turning sleep into a score-based target or competition
tasks.explanation_hebrew: gamifying פירושו להפוך פעילות למשחק עם ניקוד ויעדים, דבר שעלול ליצור לחץ.

tasks.prompt: Describe Jess Hill's experience with her Garmin scores and why her attitude changed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את ההסתמכות על השעון, השפעת הציונים והאירוע שהמחיש את חוסר ההתאמה.
expected_points: She treated the watch as an authority on her sleep
Her fixation lasted about three years
Low scores made her expect a difficult day
High scores made her push through tiredness
She noticed the watch did not match her experience
It reported great sleep although she was awake from 01:00 to 05:00

tasks.prompt: Why can attempts to optimise every detail of sleep become self-defeating?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את מעגל החרדה באמצעות ראיות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Scores create a target
Users worry about quantity and quality
Anxiety can worsen sleep
Trackers may estimate stages inaccurately
Even reassuring tests may not end the fixation
Scores can affect daytime feelings
Sleep does not respond well to attempts to perfect it

tasks.prompt: Summarise the concerns, evidence and practical advice about sleep tracking.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול sleepmaxxing, orthosomnia, מגבלות המדידה, המחקר וההמלצות.
expected_points: Sleepmaxxing is the effort to optimise sleep
Orthosomnia is obsession with perfect sleep
Doctors see tracker-related anxiety
Sleep scores are not a recognised scientific measure
Wrist trackers mainly infer sleep from movement
Random negative scores increased reported fatigue
Experts advise a reasonably cool, dark and quiet room
Morning light, light exercise, a varied diet and simplicity can help

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced message to a friend anxious about an imperfect sleep score.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית בטון מרגיע, עם לפחות ארבע נקודות מהכתבה וללא אבחון רפואי.
expected_points: Acknowledge that trackers can raise awareness
Explain that sleep scores are not clinical measures
Mention that wrist devices estimate from movement
Explain that scores can affect expectations
Encourage attention to actual feelings
Suggest a coolish, darkish and quietish room
Mention morning light or light exercise
Recommend professional advice for genuine concerns
